cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only here to hold the tools. I'll get your boiler running; leave these controls to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll have him handle the boiler while I coordinate the checks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's on the phone. He wants to know what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions. You take the readings he needs, and I'll decide when we've checked enough.
